graphics.layout: row-major cells, each cell is 2 columns by 4 rows of pins

braille.layout: one left-to-right line, Unicode braille dot 1 through 8 bits
braille.frame_size: braille_cells bytes; shorter inputs are padded with zero cells

operations.refresh_graphics: resubmit the last successful graphic frame
operations.refresh_braille: resubmit the last successful braille line

completion: SDK submission only, not physical pin completion

command.hex: two hexadecimal digits per raw byte
